Have you ever stopped to wonder why you see the world the way you do? Most of us carry around beliefs that feel like solid ground—guiding our choices and coloring every experience. But what if some of those beliefs are rooted in assumptions we've never really questioned?
Together, we're about to set off on a journey inspired by Larry Gottlieb's thought-provoking book, Hoodwinked: Uncovering Our Fundamental Superstitions. It's an invitation to peek behind the curtain and explore the subtle myths that quietly shape our lives—ideas so woven into our thinking, they can seem like simple common sense.
As we dig into where these beliefs come from, we'll start to see how they influence not just our sense of self, but our relationships and even the stories we tell about reality itself. What happens when we peel back those layers of “inherited wisdom”? Well, certainty gives way to possibility—and suddenly, there’s room for new ways of seeing and being.
So, if you're ready to question what you've always accepted as truth, and maybe even discover a more genuine, free way to engage with the world, you're in the right place. Let's explore these ideas together and open the door to a deeper understanding—not just of the world, but of ourselves.
